caption:
Sometimes the hard part isn’t the feedback. It’s feeling a little farther from the group you used to be fully inside.

Save this if that part of management feels more real than anyone warned you about.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #womeninleadership

slides.headline: Nobody tells you becoming a manager can feel a little <u>lonely</u>, even when you’re with your team all day.
